title: Resolve source-independence admission using real external evidence without weakening the quorum rule
scope: audit the current source independence rule and its network-owner evidence
determine whether a genuinely independent third source is required
if an additional source is introduced, require distinct network ownership and fresh result comparison
keep ketqua16.net as declared primary target
keep xsmb.com.vn as identity source B unless evidence proves a safer replacement
never treat hostname difference as independence
never promote canonical quorum from same-owner sources
record source ownership evidence and timestamps in durable forensic envelopes
completion_gate: Source independence is either genuinely proven by cross-owner fresh evidence or remains DENY with an explicit reason. No synthetic source and no policy weakening.
successor_instruction: Do not force quorum green. If independent ownership cannot be proven, preserve DENY and document the exact missing evidence.
